info.name: Mini Kanban API - Manual Test Flow
info.description:
Manual Postman flow for the Mini Kanban NestJS API.

Run requests one-by-one in numeric order. The collection uses post-response scripts only to capture tokens and IDs for later requests; there are no automated assertion tests.

Prerequisites:
- Docker PostgreSQL running
- NestJS backend running on http://localhost:3001

If you want to start over, run request 00.1 again. It creates new unique test emails and clears saved IDs/tokens.

request.description: Run this first. It creates unique owner/member emails and clears saved tokens/IDs. Expected response: API status/health object.
